learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge about the importance of engineering and professional ethics.
Learn about the design process and steps in engineering.
Acquire information about different tasks in engineering such as analysis, testing, research and development, sales, management, and consultancy.

Learn what needs to be done during and after the education process for a good engineering career. Acquire knowledge about the importance of manufacturing and the basic functions of the manufacturing process.
Gain knowledge about energy machines and construction machinery.

syllabus_topics: Engineering profession and professional ethics. Importance of engineering.
Engineering design process and steps. Design examples.
Different tasks in engineering. Analysis, testing, research and development, sales, management, and consultancy.
Basic goals of engineering. Importance of manufacturing and basic functions of the manufacturing process. What needs to be done for a good engineering career during and after education.
Definition of machine. Energy machines and construction machinery.
